name: unreferenced-test-file-export-reported-once
description: An export of a test file in a library whose manifest exports only its entry has no reference and sits in a file nothing outside can import. It is reported once, under the unreachable-export code, because the unreachable-export kind is derived from the unused-export kind and a finding is reported once, under the most specific code. The entry's export the test calls is reported under no code.
